item.text: {"summary":"Include carriage return in ASCII whitespace splitting","explanation":"ByAsciiWhitespace's delimiter omits '\\r', so carriage returns are preserved as fields. Add it to the delimiter character set to match the documented contract and existing regression assertion.","edits":[{"path":"absl/strings/str_split.cc","old":"return GenericFind(text, \" \\t\\v\\f\\n\", pos, AnyOfPolicy());","new":"return GenericFind(text, \" \\t\\v\\f\\n\\r\", pos, AnyOfPolicy());"}]}
